about: The version island, PR 2 (feat/pine-library-island-bool-na, engine 89, stacked on #2106): a v5 library's bools are v5 bools inside the island (bool-na and implicit-cast judged per token on the runtime lane: the run's ==/not, na() and unmatched-block rules, the columnar resolver's condition, binary operators and na()), a v5 na bool never reaches v6 code through a collection or record (handed back, an element or field of one, one the script shares; LV6), the island's bool map answers na as a v5 script's does, and the link check reads a declared type and a ?:'s arms, never its condition, and holds box.new / table.cell without their v5 object-default colours. Every per-token read, each family's membership, each boundary exit and each link-check reading, broken once, must turn its rail red.
